title: erigeron pulcherrimus var. wyomingia
intro: Erigeron pulcherrimus var. wyomingia, commonly known as the Wyoming Fleabane, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating digestive issues and sore throats, and providing relief from inflammation and fever. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which are said to help soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Erigeron pulcherrimus var. wyomingia include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
